title: Press Kits/Directories
slide_intent: Teach designers to distinguish a package that introduces many press materials from a directory that helps someone retrieve information.
strategic_value: NASA can identify both kinds of publication with the same type and mark while giving each cover an appropriate level of expression.
demonstration: The upper row compares three press-kit treatments, including the angled Viking title. The lower row compares directory covers featuring a telephone illustration, a red type-led cover and an enlarged mark.
practical_value: For a press kit, start with layout, type and issuer identification. For a directory, consider a graphic cue that helps the reader identify its function.
